home.heroStrong: A directory of independent online shops that take bitcoin directly at checkout. Look for the bitcoin or Lightning option, then scan the QR code with your wallet.
home.heroBrowse: Every shop here was confirmed by a person.
home.independence: No ads, no listing fees. This directory has no affiliate links.
home.payCallout: No bitcoin yet? You can still pay.
home.payCalloutBody: Many shops here take Lightning, and some everyday money apps can pay a Lightning invoice from a dollar balance.
home.shopsH2: Sell for bitcoin? Get found by people who want to spend it.
home.shopsPoint1: Free to list, with no paid placement and no affiliate cut.
home.shopsPoint2: Galaxy Mind is listed on bitcoin.org, so bitcoin shoppers find you here.
home.shopsPoint3: You get a human-verified badge to embed on your own site.
home.shopsPoint4: Your Nostr npub or NIP-05 address is welcome, and so is an X handle.
home.shopsPoint5: A person reviews every submission, usually within 24 to 48 hours.
home.shopsEmail: Or get new shops in your inbox
home.faq1A: No. Galaxy Mind is a directory, so you buy from each shop and pay the shop directly.
home.faq2Q: Who handles shipping, returns and refunds?
home.faq2A: The shop does, under its own policies. Galaxy Mind never holds your money or your order.
home.faq3A: A person confirms that the shop takes bitcoin for the goods it sells. Each card shows the date of that check.
home.faq4A: No. You can browse the directory and buy from any shop without signing up here.
home.faq5Q: Does anyone pay to be listed?
home.faq5A: No. There are no listing fees, no paid placement and no affiliate links.
home.faq6Q: I don't own bitcoin. Can I still buy?
home.faq6A: Often, yes. Many shops take Lightning, and some everyday money apps can pay a Lightning invoice from a dollar balance, so check your app.

footer.directoryDisclaimer: Galaxy Mind is a human-verified directory of merchants that accept bitcoin, plus free instruments for reading the market. Nothing here is investment advice, tax advice, or a solicitation to buy or sell any security.
submit.lead: Paste your handle · we'll auto-pull what we can from your public profile (description, Lightning Address, website, NIP-05). Fill in what's missing, hit submit. We review within 24-48 hours. A listing goes up only after a person here confirms a bitcoin payment for a real good. There is no listing fee and no paid placement.
submit.eligibility: We only list vendors selling lawful goods and services. Anything illegal under US law, or barred by our hosting provider's acceptable-use policy, is rejected: drugs and controlled substances, gambling and betting, weapons, adult or sexually explicit content, and counterfeit or stolen goods. Bitcoin-themed products are welcome; unlawful activity is not.
submit.how: Each submission is manually confirmed accepting Bitcoin before being added to the directory. Most submissions land within 24-48 hours. The form asks for an email so we can send the outcome either way, listed or not. If you are listed that mail includes the verified-bitcoin badge for your shop.
submit.preferOld: Prefer the old way? You can also DM
submit.orNostr: or message us on Nostr (NIP-05 verified at galaxymind.space) · but the form is faster.
submit.handleHint: (X username · no @, no link · Nostr npub1… or NIP-05 name@yourdomain · not Gmail)
submit.name: 2. Brand / shop name
submit.descriptionHint: (30-300 chars · what you sell, and that you take bitcoin)
submit.websiteHint: Your shop's own site, where a person can pay in bitcoin. Typing yourshop.com is fine; we add the https://. If checkout runs on BTCPay or another processor, use your shop's address, not the processor's. A social profile is not enough.
submit.multiShop: Run more than one shop? List each one separately under the same handle.
submit.emailBody: Not added to any list. We email the outcome either way. If you are listed that mail includes the verified-bitcoin badge for your shop.
submit.notePlaceholder: Optional · only visible to the reviewer, never published.
submit.attest: This shop accepts bitcoin at checkout.
submit.attestHint: A person here confirms an on-chain or Lightning payment for a real good before anything is listed. Checking this is not a listing.
submit.needHandleShape: Handle is an X username or Nostr id, not an email
submit.needBitcoin: Description names bitcoin / BTC / Lightning / sats
submit.hintHttps: needs a web address, like yourshop.com
submit.hintGmail: Gmail / Hotmail / etc. is not an identity
submit.hintNip05: if this is a NIP-05, pick Nostr
submit.hintBitcoin: this directory only lists shops that take bitcoin
submit.hintBait: skip the plea — say the goods
submit.draftRestored: Picked up where you left off · this draft is saved only in this browser.
